title: Phandalin arrival

sourceRecords.title: 3 · Clues after the road fight
read: The woods settle. The two horses still block the road. Broken brush and small tracks lead north, away from the wagon and into thicker trees.
Among the goblins’ castoffs is a rough dark stone token. One side bears a single worn word: BELOW. The other carries part of a circle rubbed almost smooth.

sourceRecords.title: 3 · Sildar’s next step
read: Sildar scans the main street. “I will ask after Iarno and find us a place to gather our thoughts. We need something firmer than a rumor before we choose a road.”

The street gives him several places to begin an inquiry, but his glance does not settle on an answer. Shops, passing residents, and the possibility of a shared meeting place lie within reach. You can accompany him or agree where to find one another after making your own inquiries.

sourceRecords.title: Lead · Check on Gundren at the inn
read: The common room is busy enough that your return draws only a few glances. Somewhere beyond it is the room where you left Gundren.

The place you left him is the first thing to check, before any questions about the wider trouble. You can ask the keeper to take you there, find out who has been nearby, or arrange for someone to watch the approach. Gundren's present condition is something you must see for yourselves.

sourceRecords.title: Lead · The captured rat
read: Trista has the rat you captured in the hideout. How are you keeping it, and what do you want to try?

The rat's containment is something you can check before beginning an examination. What you know so far comes from the capture, not from any explanation it has given you. You can observe it, ask Trista what help she wants, or leave the question for another meeting.
